items.title: CNN fact check: Trump's 'gas cheaper than Biden' claim is false — AAA avg $4.36/gal, 39% above inauguration day
items.summary: CNN fact check (published Oct 13, 2026) dismantles Trump's claim, made at Monday's Ohio rally and repeated ~3x in the last month, that gas prices are lower now than under Biden: the AAA national average was $4.36/gal on Monday — exceeded on only 76 of Biden's 1,460 full days (~95% of Biden's presidency was cheaper); prices are 39% above the $3.12/gal average on Jan 20, 2025. CNN also flags Trump's reprised 'your other prices have all come down' line as false: CPI up 4.8% since Jan 2025. Independent Wichita Liberty fact-check (Oct 4, citing AAA/WRNJ) reached the same verdict (False) on the same claim from earlier rallies.
